sentences.en: I was used to studying when I was a student.
sentences.zh: 我过去读书时经常学习。

sentences.en: The more you study, the more you discover your ignorance.
sentences.zh: 你学得越多，就越会发现自己知道得太少。

sentences.en: We must continue to study as long as we live.
sentences.zh: 只要我们活着，就必须继续学习。

senses.zh: 学习，研究；课题；书房；学问
